netlist:
* Spicey Electrons circuit at 20 C
.options rshunt=1e12 reltol=1e-3 method=gear
.temp 20
vam_B1 n1 B1_am 0
V_B1 B1_int 0 PWL(0 0 1e-06 9)
R_B1_in B1_am B1_int 0.1
vam_K1 n1 K1_am 0
vam_K1_p1 n2 K1_p1 0
vam_K1_p2 n1 K1_p2 0
vam_K1_p3 n3 K1_p3 0
R_K1_c K1_am K1_l 225
L_K1 K1_l K1_p1 0.3375
S_K1 K1_p2 K1_p3 K1_am K1_p1 SWR_K1
vam_D1 n2 D1_am 0
D_D1 D1_am n1 1N4148
vam_Q1 n2 Q1_am 0
vam_Q1_p0 n4 Q1_p0 0
vam_Q1_p2 0 Q1_p2 0
Q_Q1 Q1_am Q1_p0 Q1_p2 2N3904
vam_R1 n5 R1_am 0
R_R1 R1_am n4 1000
vam_SQ1 n5 SQ1_am 0
V_SQ1 SQ1_int 0 PULSE(0 5 0 5e-05 5e-05 0.02495 0.05)
R_SQ1_in SQ1_am SQ1_int 0.1
vam_R2 n3 R2_am 0
R_R2 R2_am n6 470
vam_LED1 n6 LED1_am 0
D_LED1 LED1_am 0 LED_green
.model SWR_K1 SW(VT=4.725 VH=2.025 RON=0.05 ROFF=1e9)
.model 1N4148 D(IS=4.352n N=1.906 BV=110 IBV=0.0001 RS=0.6458 CJO=7.048p VJ=0.869 M=0.03 FC=0.5 TT=3.48n)
.model 2N3904 NPN(IS=6.734f XTI=3 EG=1.11 VAF=74.03 BF=416.4 NE=1.259 ISE=6.734f IKF=66.78m XTB=1.5 BR=.7371 NC=2 ISC=0 IKR=0 RC=1 CJC=3.638p MJC=.3085 VJC=.75 FC=.5 CJE=4.493p MJE=.2593 VJE=.75 TR=239.5n TF=301.2p ITF=.4 VTF=4 XTF=2 RB=10)
.model LED_green D(IS=9.9187e-20 N=2.0 RS=2.0 EG=2.600 XTI=3 BV=5 IBV=10u CJO=20p TT=10n)
.control
set filetype=binary
tran 0.0001 0.1 0 0.0001
write __OUT__ v(n1) v(n2) v(n3) v(n4) v(n5) v(n6) i(vam_b1) i(vam_k1) i(vam_d1) i(vam_q1) i(vam_r1) i(vam_sq1) i(vam_r2) i(vam_led1) i(vam_k1_p1) i(vam_k1_p2) i(vam_k1_p3) i(vam_q1_p0) i(vam_q1_p2)
quit
.endc
.end
